# Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison

## Overview
Four datasets capture different dimensions of water stress for 10 countries spanning arid, semi-arid, and water-rich regions. Together they enable a composite view of regional water crisis severity.

## Data Source

### water_supply_demand
Fields: `country` (string), `iso` (ISO 3166 alpha-3), `supply_demand_ratio` (float, renewable supply ÷ total withdrawal; values 0.31–6.12), `stress_class` (categorical: Extremely High / High / Medium-High / Medium / Low). Year: 2023 estimate.

### per_capita_freshwater
Fields: `country` (string), `per_capita_m3` (integer, cubic meters per person per year; range 84–80,620). Year: 2023 estimate. The 1,000 m³ threshold is commonly used to indicate water scarcity.

### groundwater_extraction
Fields: `country` (string), `extraction_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `recharge_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `extraction_recharge_ratio` (float; values 0.05–5.66). Ratio > 1.0 signals overdraft. Year: 2023 estimate.

### precipitation_trends

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np

# Data - ordered by supply_demand_ratio ascending (most stressed first)
countries = ['Saudi Arabia', 'Egypt', 'Pakistan', 'India', 'South Africa', 'Mexico', 'Australia', 'United States', 'Brazil', 'Canada']
short = ['SAU', 'EGY', 'PAK', 'IND', 'ZAF', 'MEX', 'AUS', 'USA', 'BRA', 'CAN']

supply_demand = [0.31, 0.48, 0.65, 0.72, 0.91, 1.08, 1.55, 1.82, 4.35, 6.12]
per_capita = [84, 570, 934, 1486, 830, 3656, 20180, 8844, 27436, 80620]
gw_ratio = [5.66, 1.63, 1.16, 0.58, 0.98, 0.75, 0.23, 0.88, 0.10, 0.05]

# Precipitation trend: % change from 1990s to 2010s
precip_90 = [98, 52, 396, 1120, 498, 758, 465, 767, 1761, 537]
precip_10 = [78, 41, 355, 1078, 452, 725, 478, 798, 1720, 562]
precip_pct = [100*(p1-p0)/p0 for p0,p1 in zip(precip_90, precip_10)]

n = len(countries)

# Colors: severity-based
def stress_color(sd):
    if sd < 0.7: return '#8B0000'  # dark red
    if sd < 1.0: return '#CC3311'  # red
    if sd < 1.5: return '#EE6677'  # salmon
    if sd < 2.0: return '#EE9944'  # orange
    return '#228833'  # green

colors = [stress_color(s) for s in supply_demand]

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12), facecolor='#FAFAFA')
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, hspace=0.38, wspace=0.32, left=0.08, right=0.95, top=0.88, bottom=0.06)

# Suptitle
fig.suptitle('Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison (2023)',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', y=0.96)
fig.text(0.5, 0.925, 'Countries ranked by water supply-to-demand ratio (most stressed → least stressed)',
         ha='center', fontsize=10, color='#555555')

y_pos = np.arange(n)

# --- Panel A: Supply-Demand Ratio ---
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
bars = ax1.barh(y_pos, supply_demand, color=colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, height=0.7)
ax1.axvline(x=1.0, color='#333333', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, alpha=0.7)
ax1.text(1.02, n-0.3, 'Demand = Supply', fontsize=7.5, color='#333333', style='italic')
for i, v in enumerate(supply_demand):
    ax1.text(v + 0.08, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=8, color='#333333', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax1.set_yticklabels(countries, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_xlabel('Supply ÷ Demand Ratio', fontsize=9, color='#333333')
ax1.set_title('A. Water Supply-to-Demand Ratio', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', loc='left')
ax1.set_xlim(0, 7)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax1.tick_params(colors='#555555')

# --- Panel B: Per Capita Freshwater (log scale) ---
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
bars2 = ax2.barh(y_pos, per_capita, color=colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, height=0.7)
ax2.set_xscale('log')
ax2.axvline(x=1000, color='#8B0000', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, alpha=0.7)
ax2.text(1050, n-0.3, 'Scarcity threshold\n(1,000 m³/capita)', fontsize=7, color='#8B0000', style='italic')
for i, v in enumerate(per_capita):
    ax2.text(v * 1.15, i, f'{v:,}', va='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#333333', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax2.set_yticklabels(short, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('m³ per capita per year (log scale)', fontsize=9, color='#333333')
ax2.set_title('B. Per-Capita Freshwater Availability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', loc='left')
ax2.invert_yaxis()
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax2.tick_params(colors='#555555')

# --- Panel C: Groundwater Extraction/Recharge Ratio ---
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
gw_colors = ['#8B0000' if g > 1.0 else '#CC3311' if g > 0.8 else '#228833' for g in gw_ratio]
bars3 = ax3.barh(y_pos, gw_ratio, color=gw_colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, height=0.7)
ax3.axvline(x=1.0, color='#333333', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, alpha=0.7)
ax3.text(1.05, n-0.3, 'Overdraft threshold', fontsize=7.5, color='#333333', style='italic')
for i, v in enumerate(gw_ratio):
    offset = 0.1 if v < 5 else -0.8
    ax3.text(v + offset, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=8, color='#333333', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax3.set_yticklabels(countries, fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xlabel('Extraction ÷ Recharge Ratio', fontsize=9, color='#333333')
ax3.set_title('C. Groundwater Extraction vs. Recharge', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', loc='left')
ax3.invert_yaxis()
ax3.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax3.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax3.tick_params(colors='#555555')

# --- Panel D: Precipitation Trend ---
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
precip_colors = ['#8B0000' if p < -10 else '#CC3311' if p < 0 else '#228833' for p in precip_pct]
bars4 = ax4.barh(y_pos, precip_pct, color=precip_colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, height=0.7)
ax4.axvline(x=0, color='#333333', linewidth=0.8)
for i, v in enumerate(precip_pct):
    ha = 'left' if v >= 0 else 'right'
    offset = 0.3 if v >= 0 else -0.3
    ax4.text(v + offset, i, f'{v:+.1f}%', va='center', ha=ha, fontsize=8, color='#333333', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax4.set_yticklabels(short, fontsize=9)
ax4.set_xlabel('% Change in Mean Precipitation (1990s → 2010s)', fontsize=9, color='#333333')
ax4.set_title('D. Decadal Precipitation Trend', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', loc='left')
ax4.invert_yaxis()
ax4.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax4.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax4.tick_params(colors='#555555')

# Source note
fig.text(0.08, 0.01, 'Data: FAO AQUASTAT / WRI Aqueduct estimates, 2023. Precipitation: country-wide spatial averages, 1990–2020.',
         fontsize=7.5, color='#888888', style='italic')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, facecolor='#FAFAFA', bbox_inches='tight')
print('Saved')
